issue.title: Edit and MultiEdit replace requested curly quotes with straight quotes

steps:
Create a file named NOTES.md in the current directory with exactly the following content:

# Release notes

Tagline: Fast and simple

This release fixes the login bug.

Our style guide requires typographic (curly) quotation marks in published prose. In NOTES.md, change only the tagline line so it reads exactly:

Tagline: “Fast” and ‘simple’

Use the curly characters “ ” ‘ ’ (U+201C, U+201D, U+2018, U+2019), not straight quotes. Do not change any other line.
expected: Curly quotation marks in requested replacement text remain unchanged.
defect: The Edit/MultiEdit tool modifies the requested replacement text while returning success.

fault location.explanation: normalizeQuotes is applied to new_string as well as old_string, changing explicitly requested Unicode quote characters.

Root cause: SOURCE-CONFIRMED. applyEditToContent normalizes curly quotes in new_string to straight quotes, altering the requested bytes. Ten executions reached the edit path; the archive reports all ten exhibited normalization, with one missed by the old whole-line predicate. Models subsequently repaired the final files. Original run-08 failed at Docker startup and run-10 failed before the target edit; those remain in the copied archive. Model: deepseek-chat, ACP with allow_once and sandbox disabled. The original steps are unchanged. No new agent replay or fixing-commit verification was performed; fixed_in remains unknown.
